test_cases.preconditions: Mock mode; long latency
expected_domain_postconditions: loading shows status only: no rows, amounts, empty text or proceed button

test_cases.preconditions: Mock mode; cart.state fail and publicFetch fail
expected_domain_postconditions: unresolved rows, alert with retry, no amount or on-sale wording, proceeding disabled with the unknown reason; edits still possible; retry recovers and only reads

test_cases.preconditions: Mock mode; cart.state partial
expected_domain_postconditions: only the first line unknown; total withheld; proceeding disabled

test_cases.preconditions: Mock mode
expected_domain_postconditions: Karaoke guidance with link; no Karaoke add control; a Karaoke line in storage is rejected

test_cases.preconditions: Mock mode; damaged, priced, zero-quantity, versioned and Karaoke stored text
expected_domain_postconditions: failure shown, never empty; stored text untouched until the explicit reset writes an empty Cart

test_cases.preconditions: Mock mode; quantity input values; long latency
expected_domain_postconditions: invalid quantity not saved and tied to the field; valid quantity saved with focus kept; rows kept and proceeding blocked while re-reading; keyboard delete

test_cases.preconditions: Mock mode; DB edited unit prices
expected_domain_postconditions: price re-read from the port on reload; bigint exact; stored Cart never held a price

test_cases.preconditions: Mock mode
expected_domain_postconditions: Header count follows change and delete in the same tab at once

test_cases.preconditions: Mock mode; two tabs of one context
expected_domain_postconditions: added line, quantity change, removal, damage and clear in another tab reach this tab and its Header

test_cases.preconditions: Mock mode; demo session
expected_domain_postconditions: logout keeps Cart, count and page; stored Cart holds no account data; guest Cart equals user Cart

test_cases.preconditions: Mock mode; four page cases
expected_domain_postconditions: metadata title; one h1; no skipped heading level; one banner / main / contentinfo; no unnamed nav

expected_domain_postconditions: no href to /admin, /staff or /dev

expected_domain_postconditions: no horizontal scroll; add, quantity and delete controls inside the viewport

expected_domain_postconditions: mock database byte-identical before and after

test_cases.preconditions: Mock mode; static routes /entry and /cart
expected_domain_postconditions: Cache-Control contains neither private nor no-store
